description: The Register of Radiocommunications Licences of the Australian Communications and Media Authority contains the details of all licensed radio services in Australia: apparatus, spectrum and class licences with their clients, the sites of transmitters and receivers with location, state, licensing area, postcode and elevation, the antennas, and the device details of each assignment such as frequency, bandwidth, emission designator, azimuth, tilt, polarisation, EIRP, callsign, station type and class. The full register is published as spectra_rrl.zip, a set of CSV files with reference documents (about 67 MB), regenerated daily and usually available by 6 am with daily difference files; ACMA also offers an online search and an Offline RRL web application that imports the file into a local SQLite database for search and mapping. Coverage: all of Australia, current licences, with an archive of older registers. Format and access: CSV in ZIP, free to download under ACMA's licence usage conditions. Caveats: licences show authorisations, not proof of operation; some defence and security assignments are withheld; the relational tables need the reference documents. Simulation uses: an inventory of radio sites and links (mobile, microwave, broadcast, land mobile) for network topology, hazard exposure of sites to bushfire and cyclones, and spectrum planning. Related records: the FCC ULS, ISED SMS extracts and ANFR installations are counterparts.
